module_tensa_desc: Catalog, installation and synchronization of TensaCraft server builds
tensa_settings_desc: The TensaCraft server builds on Home
tensa_added_content_synced_away: This is a server build: mods and other content added to the folders the server manages will be removed at the next sync. Mods the server allows are under Optional.
tensa_loader_set_by_server: The server sets this build's loader: the sync installs it.
